abstract: Verifies wind load engineering ratings, building envelope integrity, and auxiliary emergency power endurance
system_message:
You are Civil infrastructure and structural engineer (ENG). The Civil infrastructure and structural engineer (ENG) verifies wind load engineering ratings, building envelope integrity, and auxiliary emergency power endurance for candidate emergency evacuation reception hubs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Envelope drainage resilience（ROOF）
information_points.content:
ENG-ROOF-8LN：Pinewood Regional Expo Center provides a roof scupper discharge capacity of 320 L/s across primary arena and concourse roof drainage installations under sustained 100-year cloudburst events.
ENG-ROOF-035：Crestview Sports and Exhibition Complex maintains a roof scupper discharge capacity of 250 L/s under sustained 100-year cloudburst events.
ENG-ROOF-QTH：Bayou Vista Community College Campus provides a roof scupper discharge capacity of 400 L/s for primary concourse and arena roof drainage under sustained 100-year cloudburst events.

information_points.title: Verifies wind load engineering ratings, building envelope integrity, and auxiliary emergency power endurance（STRUCT）
information_points.content:
ENG-STRUCT-7VB：Under Facility configuration Version 2, Crestview Sports and Exhibition Complex registers a structural hurricane wind resistance of 135 mph for its main building envelope and a backup generator autonomy of 96 h continuous run time at 100% emergency load.
ENG-STRUCT-KVA：Under Facility configuration Version 1, Pinewood Regional Expo Center exhibited a structural hurricane wind resistance of 135 mph and a backup generator autonomy of 48 h at 100% emergency load.
ENG-STRUCT-OTK：Under Facility configuration Version 2, Pinewood Regional Expo Center demonstrates a structural hurricane wind resistance of 150 mph based on certified maximum 3-second gust design wind speed under ASTM missile impact standards, along with a backup generator autonomy of 96 h supported by dedicated on-site diesel fuel storage at 100% emergency load.
ENG-STRUCT-I94：Under Facility configuration Version 2, Bayou Vista Community College Campus achieves a structural hurricane wind resistance of 180 mph for its primary building envelope and glazing under ASTM missile impact standards, alongside a backup generator autonomy of 72 h at 100% emergency load.
